name: Le Viking

features.name: Raid Spins
features.description: Six coins trigger a sticky respin round with three refilling lives.

features.name: Coin tiers
features.description: Bronze, silver and gold coins plus diamonds reveal cash values.

features.name: Clovers
features.description: Green and gold clovers boost nearby or all coin values.

review:
Smokey in a horned helmet. The main event is Raid Spins: land six coins of any kind and you enter a hold-and-win round with three lives, where coins, diamonds and clovers stick until it ends.

Every new coin, diamond or clover resets you to three lives; three blank respins in a row and it's over. At the end, coins and diamonds reveal cash values (bronze can be as low as 0.2x) and clovers boost what's around them. Familiar format, Hacksaw touches. 10,000x max.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
